text:
Maya: Uploaded cross-cloud runs for identical nVidia T4 SKU across AWS/GCP/Azure. Charts + raw traces: https://redwood.infra/reports/1773123456
Sam: TL;DR: p50 similar, p95/P99 worse on GCP by ~8-12% for 512/1024 tokens. throughput ~same.
Igor: Did you match driver/CUDA and kernel? tiny diffs can blow up.
Maya: Yes, driver 525.89 everywhere, CUDA 11.8. But kernels differ: AWS 5.15.0-1023-aws, GCP 5.15.0-1054-gcp, Azure 5.15.0-1013-azure. Also different NVLINK/PCI topology exposed.
Hao: From traces I'm seeing more memcpy small chunk stalls on GCP. Might be PCIe ASPM or platform BIOS.
Maya: nsys capture command used:
```
nsys profile --trace=cuda,osrt --output=run_gcp_512 --sample=none --force ./bench_runner --model /models/7b --batch 1 --seq_len 512
```
Sample trace snippet:
```
Memcpy H2D size=8192 start=12345 end=12350 stall=5us
Kernel launch: aten::matmul start=12360 end=13000
Memcpy D2H size=256 start=13010 end=13012 stall=2us
```
Sam: Did you check CPU governor? On GCP some VMs default to ondemand which causes jitter.
Leah: Also check IOMMU and iommu=pt vs iommu=force on boot. We've seen huge memcpy tail on machines with iommu overhead.
Igor: Can you run microbench disabling ASPM and setting governor=performance and retest? Also try setting `nvidia_persistent_mode=1`.
Maya: Will run 3 quick toggles: (1) governor=performance (2) iommu=pt (3) persistent_mode on. Scheduling them across regions.
deploy-bot: perf-runner started job pr-1773123489 for toggles across aws/gcp/azure
Maya: Early results: toggles fixed ~6-9% of p99 on GCP. Remaining gap correlates with PCIe link speed (GCP showing gen3 vs AWS gen4 in our instances).
Hao: If PCIe gen mismatch, consider packing different instance type or accept perf delta and route latency-sensitive traffic away from GCP.
Sam: Ops: can we standardize AMI images with these kernel params for Dedicated clusters? If yes, we can keep host parity.
Maya: I'll open an RFC with measured numbers and recommended AMIs + boot flags.
Leah: Also add a note about BIOS firmware versions—Azure had older firmware on some machines.
Maya: RFC will include per-region p50/p95/p99 tables, throughput, and nsys links. Re-running full suite next week.
Sam: Thanks, this helps planning capacity for Dedicated bookings. :+1:
